entry.title: ATARNEA
entry.text: ATARNEA, an ancient town of Myfn, flatuated between Akrimytition and Plans, remarkable for the marriage of Arribite with the filter or consecutive of the tyrant Hermias; also for the dotage of that phi-lolopier.
